name: 2Chat
description: 2Chat is a conversational commerce automation tool for WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, and SMS.

events.d: Creates a new contact with phone, WhatsApp, email, or address details (at least one required).
Create a new WhatsApp channel by providing phone number and friendly name.
Retrieve all contacts, with optional page number and results per page.
Retrieve all WhatsApp numbers registered in your 2Chat account.
Retrieve WhatsApp messages for a selected WhatsApp number; optionally filter by contact and page.
Checks whether a number is registered on WhatsApp using your sender number or optional extra information.
Retrieve all WhatsApp groups for a specified WhatsApp number.
Runs when a new WhatsApp message is received for a selected WhatsApp number.
Runs when a new WhatsApp message is sent in 2Chat.
Runs when a new WhatsApp message is sent or received.
Runs when a new WhatsApp call is received on a chosen number.
Runs when a new WhatsApp conversation starts on a chosen 2Chat number.
Runs when someone reacts to a message.
Runs when a message is edited in 2Chat, including edits in group conversations.
Runs when a new WhatsApp group message is received
Runs when new WhatsApp group message reaction occurs for a chosen WhatsApp number.
Runs when a new participant joins a selected WhatsApp group.
Runs when a participant is removed from a WhatsApp group
Runs when a connected WhatsApp number's status is updated; select which number to monitor.
Sets the About text on your 2Chat-connected WhatsApp number.
Set the profile picture for a selected WhatsApp number using an image URL.
Send a WhatsApp text, media, or location message to a phone, group, or remote ID.
Sends text or media (image, video, doc, audio) via URL to a chosen WhatsApp group from a selected sender number.
Add a product to a WhatsApp Business catalog.
Checks whether a given phone number has an active WhatsApp account.
Create a WhatsApp group by setting name, description, from number, and up to 10 participants.

events.n: Add Participants to a WhatsApp Group
events.d: Add one or more phone numbers to an existing WhatsApp group, choosing the sender number and group.
Remove a participant from a chosen WhatsApp group by group ID and participant ID.
Update an existing contact's name, profile photo, channel, or contact details.
Delete a contact from your directory by selecting its contact ID.
Search contacts by phone number, name, or channel.

events.n: Get WhatsApp Messages by Phone Number
events.d: Fetch WhatsApp messages for a connected number.
Get all participants of a WhatsApp group.
